purpose: Retrospective hypothesis screen for morning entry and same-session close; not validation of a trading rule
main_exclusions: all 200 production holdout tickers frozen from full registry
prior_validity: 252 preceding SPY-calendar sessions have finite positive OHLCV with low<=open,close<=high and low<=high; tolerance 1e-5 to align cache construction
evaluation_validity: Current open must be finite positive and >=5 for entry eligibility. Current valid OHLCV required for outcome availability; missing/invalid outcome counts are separate. No forward-horizon completeness or cooldown. No price-return magnitude rejection.
prior252_low: min(L[t-252:t]); Python right endpoint t is exclusive
new_low: L[t-1] <= min(L[t-252:t-1]) (251 previous lows), plus 1e-10 relative numeric tolerance
recovery_fraction: (O[t]-C[t-1])/(C[t-3]-C[t-1]); used only when both prior returns meet main shock
same_date_baseline: Mean of all evaluated eligible names that date, plus separate mean excluding cohort members with at least five remaining controls
matching: On each date, entry-eligible names ranked before current-outcome availability filtering by pre-shock volatility with ticker-sorted stable tie-breaking; quintile=floor(zero-based rank*5/N). std20 of daily close-close returns ending t-3 uses ddof=1. Match each cohort member to same-date,same-quintile eligible names excluding all members of that cohort. Require >=5 controls per stratum. Residuals first averaged within date, then equally across active covered dates. All-eligible matched excess is undefined.
return_aggregation: Equal-weight stocks within cohort/date, then equal-weight active dates. Median, positive fraction, adverse-excursion mean/p05 are row-level descriptive metrics.
cost_model: Net return=gross return-roundtrip_bps/10000, constant arithmetic sensitivity not measured execution costs

bootstrap.method: Sample the observed active ISO weeks with replacement preserving every active date in each sampled week; mean equals sum of sampled weekly sums divided by sum of sampled weekly active-date counts
bootstrap.interval: 2.5th/97.5th bootstrap percentiles of equal-active-date matched excess
bootstrap.limitations: Retrospective dependence sensitivity; not multiple-testing-corrected discovery and not a genuinely untouched holdout

winsorization: Within each reported cohort/era, clip row returns at 1st/99th percentiles then equal-date aggregate. For matched residual sensitivity, clip covered row residuals at their 1st/99th percentiles before equal-date aggregation. Descriptive, never selects cohorts.
sparse_label: fewer than100 rows OR20 active dates OR10 active weeks; matched uncertainty sparse if fewer than10 covered weeks
quality_counters: Missing/nonfinite bars, nonpositive prices/volume, OHLC-range inconsistencies; absolute return>20%,>50%,>100% retained and counted; minimum/maximum return and busiest-date concentration
limitations: Current registry has survivorship and present-day size selection bias
Current static sectors are not historical classifications; matching only date and volatility
Split-adjusted daily cache excludes dividends and lacks full five-year corporate-action certification
Absolute $5 historical filter uses retrospectively adjusted price basis
MRCY-inspired hypotheses and previously studied history are retrospective; later eras are temporal diagnostics, not untouched confirmatory holdout
Daily open/close are benchmark prices, not guaranteed executable fills
No overnight holding, averaging down, exit optimization, model training or production feature modification

pre_outcome_clarifications.detail: Quintiles use entry-eligible names before invalid-current-outcome exclusion. Open-conditioned cohorts are an idealized open-mark study; observing the open does not guarantee a fill at that open. Recovery bins describe overnight recovery of the prior two-close loss, not recovery from the intraday low.

Parent approved two standalone low-context cohorts before any outcome calculation: all eligible prior close near252low, and all eligible yesterday new/tied252low. These isolate low context from the double-shock conjunction. No additional cohorts or optimization.

mrcy_inclusion_amendment.reason: User explicitly requested MRCY be included in the primary analysis after seeing the initial MRCY-excluded results. Include its entire eligible history, not just the motivating rebound date.
mrcy_inclusion_amendment.timing: After original outcomes were calculated and reviewed; this amendment is not represented as prospectively frozen before the original results.
mrcy_inclusion_amendment.unchanged: All 17 cohort definitions, eligibility thresholds, cost scenarios, matching algorithm, weekly bootstrap, date cutoff, and production ticker holdout. Recompute date-volatility quintiles and controls on the MRCY-inclusive eligible universe.
mrcy_inclusion_amendment.interpretation: User-directed inclusion sensitivity and revised primary universe; neither version is an untouched confirmatory test. These descriptive trigger screens do not determine whether continuous features help the existing model.
